reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in his #central-random thread to confirm his correction: the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats. That number replaces the one he posted in #central-team this morning.

He said no action was needed, so I didn't change or post anything else. Repeating the seat count was fine because it's an account fact rather than a money figure, and he had already posted it in that channel. In the reply I pointed out that he may want to post the correction in #central-team himself.
